regionalModel: Metropolitan French reference; regional variants require review

lessons.title: A brief /t/ in café words
lessons.objective: Place the tongue near the upper front teeth for French /t/ and move into the following vowel without a strong puff of air.
lessons.focus: Compare tasse, table, tarte, and tôt. Keep the /t/ release brief, then sustain the following vowel without turning it into an English glide.

words.fr: Je voudrais une tasse de thé.
words.en: I would like a cup of tea.

words.fr: La tarte est sur la table.
words.en: The tart is on the table.

words.fr: Puis-je avoir le ticket de caisse ?

reader.fr: J'arrive tôt au café et je m'assieds à une table.
reader.en: I arrive at the café early and sit at a table.

reader.fr: Je demande une tasse de thé et une part de tarte.
reader.en: I ask for a cup of tea and a slice of tart.

reader.fr: La tarte est sur la table à côté de ma tasse.
reader.en: The tart is on the table next to my cup.

reader.fr: Avant de partir, je demande le ticket.
reader.en: Before leaving, I ask for the receipt.

speaking.scene: Ordering tea and tart at a café
speaking.opening: Bonjour, je voudrais une tasse de thé.
goals: Ask whether the tart is on the table.
speaking.closure: Merci, j'ai le ticket de caisse.

see.prompt: Read tasse, table, tarte, and thé while locating the initial /t/ sound.

recall.prompt: Recall the French word for tart before revealing it.

hear.prompt: Listen for tasse or tarte in the recorded café order.

type.prompt: Type the French sentence for 'I would like a cup of tea.'
type.answerRef: Je voudrais une tasse de thé.

say.prompt: Ask the server for the receipt using a brief /t/ in ticket.
say.answerRef: Puis-je avoir le ticket de caisse ?

write.prompt: Write two French sentences ordering tea and tart and asking for the receipt.

lessons.title: Keep /n/ and /l/ distinct
lessons.objective: Begin French words with a clear /n/ or /l/ and carry the distinction into a short library conversation.
lessons.focus: For /n/, touch the tongue near the upper front teeth and let air pass through the nose; for /l/, let air flow around the tongue. Compare note and livre before joining them in a phrase.

words.en: I am reading a new book.

words.fr: Je note le nom du livre.
words.en: I write down the name of the book.

words.fr: La lampe est près du livre.
words.en: The lamp is near the book.

reader.fr: Lundi, je cherche un nouveau livre à la bibliothèque.
reader.en: On Monday, I look for a new book at the library.

reader.fr: Une lampe éclaire la table des nouveautés.
reader.en: A lamp lights the new-arrivals table.

reader.fr: Je note le nom du livre que je choisis.
reader.en: I write down the name of the book I choose.

reader.fr: Je le lis chez moi et je le rends lundi prochain.
reader.en: I read it at home and return it next Monday.

speaking.scene: Finding and borrowing a book at a library
speaking.opening: Bonjour, je cherche un nouveau livre.
goals: Repeat its name and write a note.

see.prompt: Sort note, nom, nouveau, livre, lampe, and lundi by their initial consonant.

recall.prompt: Recall the French word for book before revealing it.

hear.prompt: Listen for note or livre in the recorded library sentence.

type.prompt: Type the French sentence for 'I write down the name of the book.'
type.answerRef: Je note le nom du livre.

say.prompt: Tell the librarian that you are reading a new book.

write.prompt: Write two French sentences naming the book and stating when you will return it.
